verdict.rationale: Babylon.js's own docs claim cross-platform compatibility for web, mobile and desktop, and say it runs natively via Babylon Native. That covers the desktop and mobile parts of the story, but only through one-line claims. Nothing in the pack mentions console export, directly or through partners. Missing for 10: any console export path (direct or partner), detailed docs on packaging one project for desktop and mobile, and hands-on corroboration of native exports.

support.subject: As a studio lead, one project exports to desktop, mobile, and (directly or via partners) consoles

citations.quote: Cross-Platform: Runs seamlessly on web browsers and natively with Babylon Native
